name: prone floor flutter kicks (arms extended)
description: Small alternating leg lifts while lying face down with the arms extended, mainly working the glutes and the backs of the thighs.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms reaching forward and your legs extended behind you.
Keep your hips in contact with the floor and your neck relaxed.
Keep the trunk long and lift one straight leg slightly as the other lowers.
Alternate in small controlled kicks without forcing an arch in the lower back.
